title: Sis GO Plus Isotonic Energy Gel 60ml $1.75 (Was $3.50) @ Coles
body:
Deal: Sis GO Plus Isotonic Energy Gel 60ml $1.75 (Was $3.50) @ Coles

[Ozvalue] Is this good for working long hours.. instead of drinking energy drinks? Asking for a friend
[Kiwi131313] Different to energy drinks. This has no caffeine. It's essentially a sugar gel (this one has electrolytes too) for endurance sports.
[tenpercent] So it's just a thickened gatorade? Or is it more like cake icing with fruity flavours?
[linkser] Ah I didn't spot them yesterday when I saw the Winners gel also on 1/2 price. Good deal for a quite big gel.
[LuckyDrew] They have less carbs than the smaller winners but you can take them without water easier. More liquid less viscous.
[donkcat] Personal preference but I find winners easier to get down without water, that 15ml less volume of winners makes a difference
[chickens] winners tastes like dogshit compared to sis though
[donkcat] Would have thought its a little late to be trying new gels for Sydney mara OP
[LLP] For anyone who has already bought the gels at Coles, could you please let me know the best before date? I’m thinking of stocking up while they’re half price. 😊
[Usemame] could be just me but their blackcurrent tasted so awful right out of the box. Having them cold/cool was much better tho.
[JustValerie] Sydney Marathon is in 2 weeks… 👀
Bulk buy time!!
[braddsey] They're a pretty big gel relative to the carb's you get. 60ml gel for 22g carbs.
Compare to Maurten which are 40g gel for 25g carbs.
Precision Hydration 51g gel for 30g carbs.
Winners 45g gel for 29.8g carbs.
No reason these are better than the Winners gels. All you're trying to do is get carbs (sugar) in without choking and without sh*tting yourself.
